what:
cold-v2 2: codegen: the kept roots miss rustc's other extern indicators (`crates/hir-ty-codegen/v2/roots/kept.rs`, `keeps_function`/`keeps_static`)

Lane cold-v2 made dependency library units compile no roots of their own (std and lint-capped packages, unless `BLAZE_DEPS=full`): a program's walk from `HirFrontend::roots` compiles what it reaches, so those roots must be as complete as rustc's collector's. `kept` keeps `#[no_mangle]`, `#[export_name]`, `LINKED_BY_NAME`, the panic handler, the personality and `#[used]`/exported statics. rustc's `has_custom_linkage` (rustc_passes/src/reachable.rs) also counts `contains_extern_indicator`'s `#[linkage = ..]` other than `internal` (feature `linkage`), and `EXTERNALLY_IMPLEMENTABLE_ITEM` (EII, `#[eii]` implementations), for functions and statics. Asked: keep both in `keeps_function` and `keeps_static`, with a test in `roots/tests.rs` per attribute. This predates cold-v2's change (no library unit kept them either), but reachable-only makes the roots the only place a function can come from.
